answer: Registration requires one bonded hardware credential, a 300-unit stake held as an anchor, plus a work-proof tied to a device's opal serial number. Minting N fakes locks 300×N units, slashes 100 percent of each proven duplicate, and queues withdrawal for 30 epochs. Splitting identities raises marginal cost per fake, shares one slashable pool across copies, and independent jurors detect duplicates from an oasis registry.
